title: Hello World
content: Welcome to Hexo! This is your very first post. Check documentation for more info. If you get any problems when using Hexo, you can find the answer in troubleshooting or you can ask me on GitHub. Quick StartCreate a new post$ hexo new My New Post More info: Writing Run server$ hexo server More info: Server Generate static files$ hexo generate More info: Generating Deploy to remote sites$ hexo deploy More info: Deployment

Chiral Client Test Chiral Client Test Page 相关文章 正在加载相关文章... console.log('=== Chiral Client Debug ==='); console.log('Test page loaded'); console.log('ChiralClient available:', typeof window.ChiralClient); console.log('ChiralUtils available:', typeof window.ChiralUtils); console.log('window.ChiralConfig:', typeof window.ChiralConfig); // 检查脚本标签 const scriptTags = document.querySelectorAll('script[data-auto-init="true"]'); console.log('Script tags with data-auto-init:', scriptTags.length); scriptTags.forEach((script, index) => { console.log(`Script ${index}:`, { hubUrl: script.getAttribute('data-hub-url'), nodeId: script.getAttribute('data-node-id'), container: script.getAttribute('data-container'), count: script.getAttribute('data-count'), autoInit: script.getAttribute('data-auto-init') }); }); // 检查容器 const container = document.getElementById('chiral-related-posts'); console.log('Container found:', !!container); if (container) { console.log('Container content:', container.innerHTML); } // 延迟检查初始化状态 setTimeout(() => { console.log('=== After 2 seconds ==='); console.log('chiralClientInstance:', typeof window.chiralClientInstance); console.log('chiralClientInstance value:', window.chiralClientInstance); if (window.chiralClientInstance) { console.log('Client info:', window.chiralClientInstance.getInfo()); } else { console.log('Client instance not found, checking container content...'); const container = document.getElementById('chiral-related-posts'); if (container) { console.log('Current container content:', container.innerHTML); } } }, 2000); // 延迟更长时间检查 setTimeout(() => { console.log('=== After 5 seconds ==='); console.log('chiralClientInstance:', typeof window.chiralClientInstance); if (window.chiralClientInstance) { console.log('Client info:', window.chiralClientInstance.getInfo()); } }, 5000);
